messages:
maria: Quick sync 11 launching a focused pricing experiment today: inline micro-estimator + split CTA routing to webinar vs demo. Draft FAQ updated: https://docs.redwood.com/sheets/pricing-mini-estimator

devon: Nice. How are we splitting traffic and where is the flag?

maria: 20% AU first wave, flag X_EXP_PRICE_EST=mini_calc_v1. Variant W -> webinar, Variant D -> demo.

ashley: Recommend a tokens/month slider (client-side) and show the computed tier label underneath. Keeps people engaged. :slider:

kevin: Client-only mapping to avoid backend churn. Pseudo: ```js
const tiers=["Free","Starter","Performance","Enterprise"];
function calcLabel(t){return tiers[Math.min(Math.floor(t/50000), tiers.length-1)];}
```

samir: I pushed alternate tier names in the doc (Performance instead of Scale). Ops prefers not to rename canonical tiers, so suggest UI-only label A/B test.

lina: Measurement: events -> pricing_estimator_open, estimator_submit, cta_click. Capture props: variant, ui_tier_label, utm_campaign.

webinar-bot: Reminder 11 add UTMs to webinar link: `?utm_source=pricing_flow&utm_campaign=mini_est_may`

kevin: Small copy idea under Performance: "Optimized for low-latency apps (typ median token latency in low tens of ms)." Samir, can infra confirm rough range?

samir: Will check with infra and propose softer phrasing if needed.

maria: Launch at 14:00 UTC to 20% AU, monitor for 90m. If no regressions we widen. I'll draft the launch note and webinar email cadence. Thanks all! :thumbsup:
